insight: In this Xcode 26 project the target uses PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup and a generated Info.plist (INFOPLIST_KEY_* build settings), so there is no plist to add UIAppFonts to. Bundle .ttf files under 2/2/Resources/ (auto-copied as resources) and register them at launch with CTFontManagerRegisterFontsForURL from Theme.registerFonts() called in the App init. Variable-font axes (Fraunces wght/SOFT/WONK/opsz) are applied via UIFontDescriptor with UIFontDescriptor.AttributeName(rawValue: kCTFontVariationAttribute as String) mapping UInt32 four-char axis tags to values, then Font(uiFont as CTFont).

To screenshot SwiftUI screens on the simulator without any tap tooling (no idb): seed state by writing the JSON store into the app data container from `xcrun simctl get_app_container <dev> <bundle> data` and setting flags with `xcrun simctl spawn <dev> defaults write <bundle> <key> -bool YES`, then add a temporary DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter hook in the view to auto-present the screen, build, and time `xcrun simctl io screenshot` against the launch. Remember app launch adds ~1s before onAppear timers start.
